purpose: Measure the complete non-production E256-H fixed-R=12 iterative core after exact H3 offset collapse, with all 416 effective-mask bytes inside the graded boundary, paired fixed/runtime-repeated H4 wiring, three explicit storage organizations, recursive hierarchy accounting, and cycle/throughput receipts. Select no production architecture.

questions.text: What are the complete recursive generic LUT6, sequential-bit, memory-bit, primitive-cell, and end-to-end combinational-level costs of each integrated 416-byte storage/H4 variant?
What marginal cost does one runtime-loaded repeated H4 tuple add over fixed (0,1,3,4) wiring within each unchanged storage organization?
What storage, logic, and cycle tradeoffs separate stationary FF, rotating FF, and H1-ineligible generic synchronous-memory organizations?
Do all six integrated tops remain byte-exact against the independent fixed-R=12 effective-mask model with input-independent protocol cycles?

construction.identity: E256-H collapsed-schedule H2 integrated measurement fixture
construction.geometry: 4 rows by 8 columns, byte index 4*column+row; byte j is word[8*j +: 8]
construction.canonical_recurrence: Z_0=P XOR K_0; Z_{r+1}=L_w(SBOX^32(Z_r)) XOR K_{r+1} for 0<=r<12
construction.linear_layer: forward H4 RowShift takes source column (column+offset[row]) mod 8, followed by AES MixColumns over GF(2) polynomial 0x11b

effective_masks.terminal_rule: K_12 excludes A_12; frozen raw material defines no A_12
effective_masks.source: collapse already-derived 1184-byte material under the same repeated H4 tuple used by the run

construction.compatibility_rule: No H2 top contains an XOF. Directly squeezing 416 bytes is a new schedule/domain and is not authorized by this gate.

h4_scope.use: one selected tuple is sampled at successful commit and repeated for every round and block until reconfiguration
h4_scope.eligibility_boundary: the runner grades only the ordered certified set; the direct hardware interface is selector-general and is not an on-chip certification catalog
h4_scope.not_authorized: arbitrary per-round H4 switching or a production selector policy

rules: cfg_begin while idle invalidates the old configuration and resets the accepted-word count
exactly thirteen cfg_valid beats are accepted while idle before cfg_commit
early or late commit, a fourteenth word, configuration while busy, or start without key_valid sets cfg_error and cannot yield a result
mask stores are not reset or claimed to zeroize secrets; key_valid gates use

ff_and_ring_cycles.round_edges: E1 through E12 execute rounds 0 through 11 with K_1 through K_12

mem_cycles.fetch_edges: E1 captures K_0 and requests K_1; E2 applies K_0
mem_cycles.round_edges: E3 through E14 execute rounds 0 through 11 with K_1 through K_12

protocol_contract.stimulus_rule: Drive all changing data/configuration and pulses on negative edges; define cycle counts by positive acceptance and done edges.

functional_coverage.block_definition: all-zero; all-ff; bytes 00..1f; bytes ff..e0; then four consecutive 32-byte blocks from SHAKE256(ASCII 'E256-H/collapse/blocks/v1')
functional_coverage.aggregate_rule: For each record in frozen nested-loop order, append a 4-byte unsigned big-endian length followed by compact canonical UTF-8 JSON; state outputs are ascending byte-index order encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters.
requirements: every RTL output equals the independent Python fixed-R=12 model
ff, ring, and mem outputs agree for equal effective masks and H4 tuple
each direct top equals its fixed counterpart at tuple (0,1,3,4)
the executed variant, material, block, H4, comparison, and cycle sets exactly equal the frozen sets
latency and initiation interval are input-independent within each variant

synthesis_contract.storage_preserved_script: read_verilog <rtl_sources>; hierarchy -check -top <top>; proc; memory -nomap; opt; check -assert; write_json <storage_json>; stat
synthesis_contract.mapped_script: read_verilog <rtl_sources>; hierarchy -check -top <top>; proc; memory -nomap; opt; techmap; opt; dffunmap; zinit -all; abc -lut 6; opt_clean; check -assert; write_json <mapped_json>; stat
synthesis_contract.depth_script: read_json <mapped_json>; hierarchy -check -top <top>; write_json <depth_before_json>; flatten; write_json <depth_after_json>; check -assert; ltp -noff
synthesis_contract.depth_rule: No optimization, techmap, or ABC may follow analysis-only flattening. The recursive primitive multiset before and flat primitive multiset after must be identical; exactly one loop-free ltp -noff length is required.
synthesis_contract.recursive_rule: recursive(m)=local(m)+sum(instance_count(m,c)*recursive(c)) independently for LUT6, sequential bits, memory bits, and primitive cells; only local primitives enter the base term and hierarchy summary totals are never added
synthesis_contract.classification_rule: Accepted sequential and memory cell families and bit-width extraction are explicit; any unclassified sequential, latch, or memory primitive invalidates the harness.
synthesis_contract.storage_boundary_rule: Every graded system top accounts for all 3328 logical effective-mask bits. State, result, protocol, and direct-H4 register bits are reported separately. A wide externalized-mask port cannot satisfy H2.
synthesis_contract.h4_delta_rule: Within each storage row, subtract fixed recursive metrics from direct recursive metrics; non-H4 storage/datapath child graphs must otherwise match.
synthesis_contract.generic_boundary: LUT6 and logic levels are generic yosys/ABC mapping artifacts. Generic memory bits are not vendor BRAM/SRAM and logic levels are not timing or Fmax.

controls.mutation: use K_r where K_(r+1) is required by a round
reverse the 32 byte lanes inside every effective-mask word

controls.required_result: detected with at least one non-fixed output witness

controls.mutation: omit the acceptance rotation that advances K_0 to K_1
consume the previous synchronous-memory word instead of the prefetched word
commit after twelve mask words and attempt start
controls.required_result: cfg_error asserted, key_valid false, and no done pulse

controls.mutation: replace the integrated 3328-bit store with a wide live input port
known synthetic hierarchy contains repeated nested children
planted accounting accumulator counts one child edge twice
compare primitive multisets before and after analysis-only flatten
controls.required_result: identical primitive multiset and one parseable loop-free depth

predictions.statement: the exact six-top coverage matrix executes, all functional/cross-variant comparisons pass, and all twelve controls are detected
recursive hierarchy arithmetic closes against the independent flat primitive multiset without omitted or duplicate child instances
every integrated system boundary accounts for exactly 3328 logical effective-mask bits in its declared FF or memory organization
analysis-only flatten preserves the mapped primitive multiset and yields one loop-free end-to-end generic logic-level result per variant
cycle counts are deterministic and equal the frozen latency/initiation constants for every input in each variant
the 416-byte normal form contains 6144 fewer logical keyed-state bits than the already-derived 1184-byte raw H3 representation
runtime repeated-H4 selection has a measurable paired marginal cost relative to fixed wiring; no exact magnitude or sign is frozen
stationary FF, rotating FF, and generic synchronous-memory organizations expose measurable logic/storage/cycle tradeoffs; no winner is predicted
recursive integrated totals differ from local-only module fields; no ratio or storage-versus-logic dominance threshold is predicted

hard_rejection_rules: Refuse the receipt if this preregistration hash, either architecture contract hash, any predecessor payload digest, frozen predecessor source hash, certified H4 set hash, material hash, AES S-box hash, or pinned tool version drifts.
Refuse unless executed variant, storage, H4, material, block, control, prediction, module, comparison, and cycle sets exactly equal the frozen sets.
Refuse on any RTL/model, storage-equivalence, fixed/direct bridge, configuration, or cycle mismatch.
Refuse if any validity control or planted mutation is missed.
Refuse if any integrated top fails to account for all 3328 logical effective-mask bits, or if external storage is presented as an H2 result.
Refuse on a recursive hierarchy cycle, omitted/double-counted child, unclassified sequential/latch/memory primitive, or mismatch against the independent flat primitive multiset.
Refuse if flatten occurs before or during mapping, if optimization occurs after analysis flatten, if the primitive multiset changes, or if depth is missing, ambiguous, or looped.
Refuse if paired fixed/direct variants change their non-H4 storage/datapath organization.
Refuse if generic results are labeled vendor resources, timing, Fmax, place-and-route, ASIC area, power, energy, zeroization, fault, or side-channel evidence.

Refuse any attempt to choose a production round count, XOF, direct-short schedule, H4 switching policy, storage winner, suite/profile/fixture/protocol, production RTL, security value, or C/H/N movement.

interpretation.internal_invalid_status: INVALID_H2_COST_HARNESS; never emitted or accepted as the canonical receipt
interpretation.scope: fixed-R=12 non-production integrated cost fixture; 416-byte effective masks collapsed from already-derived raw H3 material; one repeated H4 tuple per configuration
interpretation.passing_interpretation: Report recursive generic logic/register/memory/depth costs, paired dynamic-H4 deltas, and exact simulation cycles for all six variants without selecting a production architecture.
interpretation.next: Use the measured receipt to identify further preregistered implementation or attack questions. Any production round count, short XOF schedule, switching policy, vendor P&R, or promotion requires a separate freeze and evidence.

non_claims: This cost gate is not a cryptanalytic break, security proof, key recovery, security-bit estimate, or rotor-namespace advantage.
R=12 is a measurement fixture inherited from the collapse normal form, not a production round-count choice.
The gate loads effective masks collapsed from already-derived 1184-byte material; it does not authorize or measure a direct 416-byte XOF schedule.
The direct H4 interface repeats one tuple and is selector-general; it neither enforces the 384-entry catalog on chip nor certifies arbitrary per-round switching.
The generic synchronous-memory variants are H1-ineligible comparators and are not production memory recommendations.
Generic ABC LUT6 and logic levels are not vendor utilization, timing closure, Fmax, place-and-route, ASIC area, power, energy, zeroization, fault, or side-channel evidence.
No exact physical-cost ordering, storage winner, or storage-versus-logic dominance relationship is predicted.
No C/H/N row, E256 finding, suite, profile, fixture, protocol, or release gate closes; reviewed standard AEAD remains mandatory for real data.
